# Carver

> Carver is a local-first note-taking app for Linux, built with Rust, GTK4, and
> Libadwaita. Notes are stored as canonical Carve source in a SQLite library
> under the XDG data directory, with managed image assets kept beside it.

- Native GNOME desktop application, free and open source under the MIT license.
- Canonical Carve (`.crv`) source, with a rich-text editor, a syntax-highlighted
  source editor, and a live preview.
- Markdown import, "Paste as Markdown", and Markdown export when you need to
  meet another tool halfway.
- Saved Bases: database-style views over the notes' frontmatter properties,
  editable from the grid.
- Full-text search backed by SQLite FTS5, plus find inside the open note.
- Optional local MCP server (`carver-mcp`) for AI assistants, read-only by
  default and limited to reversible changes with `--allow-write`.
- Media and attachments are listed in a document sidebar, so images travel with
  the note instead of living in a database column.
- Library at `$XDG_DATA_HOME/carver/` (SQLite database and `assets/`); settings
  at `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/carver/config.toml`.
